articles.summary: MONDOVI, Wis., May 4, 2022 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Marten Transport, Ltd. (Nasdaq/GS:MRTN) announced today that its Board of Directors has declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.06 per share of common stock, and has also approved an increase from current availability in Marten’s share repurchase program to $50 million, or approximately 3.1 million shares,…
articles.title: MARTEN TRANSPORT ANNOUNCES QUARTERLY DIVIDEND AND AN INCREASE IN SHARE REPURCHASE PROGRAM
